embed.title: Welcome to Sunrise
embed.description:
Sunrise is a community fork of Horizon: Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 rewritten in Rust. It adds compatibility layers for Java mods (Forge now, Fabric later), several Minecraft versions and a built-in profiler. No ads, no telemetry.

**Talk:** {#general}
**Performance help:** {#profiler} (a support forum is coming)
**Pings:** {#roles}

**Website:** https://playsunrise.net
**FAQ:** https://playsunrise.net/faq
**Source:** https://github.com/sunrise-org/horizon
**Mod API gaps:** https://playsunrise.net/api-gaps
**Want to help?** https://github.com/users/arismoko/projects/1/views/2

embed.title: Rules
embed.description:
1. Be kind. No harassment, slurs or personal attacks.
2. No spam, scams or self-promotion.
3. No piracy: Sunrise needs your own copy of Minecraft: Java Edition. Don't ask for or share ways around that.
4. Keep it SFW.
5. English in public channels.
6. Help requests and bug reports go in the help channels, with details.

The team may remove messages or members that break these.

embed.title: Roles
embed.description:
Pick the topics you want to be pinged about: **Modding** (mod API and mod porting), **Compat** (Forge/Fabric compatibility and versions), **Site** (playsunrise.net and the profiler viewer).

Click a button to add the role, click it again to remove it. Only you see the answer.
